record.body: Durable law: independent consumer qualification is not complete portfolio capital until exact consumer receipts return to a producer-observable graph. Return and assimilation must preserve consumer identity, producer-court identity, provenance, replay/evidence-root quality, and standing without transferring consumer execution authority. R50 makes this law executable with PROV-O/DQV/DCAT/DCTERMS/ODRL semantics, ggen projection, and sensors 350-399. Exact qualified head 008dd897b95bec935fc8c982a95061cee68e72cb merged as 9fe8fe237601a08817cbc14f05e8dd93186e3711. Verification defect learned: pull-request checkout defaults to a synthetic merge subject unless immutable PR head is explicitly selected; exact-subject courts must checkout the intended head before asserting identity.
record.title: MEASURE R50 durable learning — consumer evidence return
